overview: The Mustang Report features updates on the Medford High School girls lacrosse team's season, the Key Club blood drive, and an upcoming cancer research fundraiser.

items.title: Girls Lacrosse Season Update
items.summary: Girls lacrosse coach Matthew Galusi discussed the team's rebuilding season, a recent win against Malden, and strong player motivation.

items.title: Key Club Blood Drive
items.summary: Key Club advisor Mr. Wilson described the high school blood drive organized with the Red Cross, which targeted 40 units of blood from roughly 60 sign-ups.

items.title: Buzz Off Cancer Fundraiser
items.summary: Mr. Richards detailed Team HEMO's participation in the upcoming Buzz Off for Kids with Cancer event at Gillette Stadium.
